verdict.rationale: Lever's 'Advanced Nurture' page confirms automated, personalized outreach and re-engagement follow-ups for past candidates, which aligns with the nurture-campaign part of the story, and Automation Hub supports emailing/tagging automation. However, there is no evidence of explicit talent-pool/prospect-pool management, sequence-level email tracking (opens/replies), or CRM-style prospect segmentation. Missing for 10: prospect pool creation/management, email sequence tracking metrics, explicit CRM terminology/workflow documentation.
